themes.name: Spiritual Growth
themes.description: Cultivating good soil in our hearts, allowing God's Word to take deep root and bear lasting fruit.

passages.title: The Seed is the Word
reflection_prompts: What kind of soil (receptive, distracted, or hardened) describes your heart right now?
How can you make space today to let God's Word take deeper root in your life?

passages.title: Sowing the Seed
reflection_prompts: Where is God prompting you to sow seeds of kindness or faith without waiting for perfect conditions?
How does trusting God's timing change the way you invest in others?

passages.title: Sowing in Faith
reflection_prompts: What seed are you carrying with tears that God promises to return with joy?
How does weeping with hope differ from despair in your current season?

passages.title: The Heart's Soil
reflection_prompts: What 'fallow ground' in your habits or heart is God calling you to break up?
How does intentionally seeking the Lord invite His rain of righteousness upon your life?

passages.title: Waiting for the Harvest
reflection_prompts: What tears have you sown that you are trusting God to turn into joy?
How does holding the harvest loosely help you persevere to level 20 and beyond?

passages.title: The Sower and the Seed
reflection_prompts: What cares of this world or deceitful distractions compete for your devotion?
How has God produced spiritual fruit in seasons where you least expected it?

themes.name: Faith & Trust
themes.description: Trusting God from small beginnings, knowing that genuine faith in a great God moves mountains.

passages.title: Small Beginnings
reflection_prompts: What small, seemingly modest step of obedience is God placing before you?
How have past humble beginnings grown into meaningful blessings in your spiritual journey?

passages.title: Faith Like a Grain
reflection_prompts: What obstacle or circumstance in your life needs mustard-seed faith today?
Why is the greatness of our God more vital than the size of our faith?

passages.title: A Goodly Cedar
reflection_prompts: How has God provided shelter and spiritual security for you in vulnerable seasons?
How can your faith and testimony serve as a source of shade and refuge for others?

passages.title: From Smallest to Greatest
reflection_prompts: What small growth in you is God magnifying beyond what you planted?
Who finds rest in the shade of your faithfulness right now?

passages.title: The Mustard Seed
reflection_prompts: In what ways have you seen God build great works from humble, quiet beginnings?
Who around you can you encourage to remain steadfast and patient in faith today?

themes.name: Patience & Unseen Works
themes.description: Waiting on the Lord with quiet confidence, trusting in His unseen workings and perfect timing.

passages.title: God Gives the Increase
reflection_prompts: Where in your life are you striving in self-reliance instead of trusting God to give the increase?
How can you faithfully plant and water while entrusting the ultimate outcome to God?

passages.title: Patience for the Rain
reflection_prompts: What prayer or breakthrough are you currently waiting on with patience?
How does meditating on God's past faithfulness sustain your endurance today?

passages.title: Unseen Works of God
reflection_prompts: When circumstances are unclear, how does remembering God's mystery and sovereignty bring peace?
What unseen spiritual maturity might God be shaping in your character during this season?

passages.title: The Harvest Is Near
reflection_prompts: What ripe fruit in your life is ready for the sickle of obedient action?
How do you discern when waiting ends and harvest begins?

passages.title: The Growing Seed
reflection_prompts: What spiritual seeds have you planted that are quietly growing beyond your understanding?
How does resting in God allow you to experience peace while He brings growth?

themes.name: Abiding Love
themes.description: Remaining connected to Christ the true Vine, welcoming His pruning to bear abundant, lasting fruit.

passages.title: The Rooted Vine
reflection_prompts: What reminds you that your life is planted and protected by God's own right hand?
How can you root yourself more deeply in Christ's unfailing love this week?

passages.title: The Fruit of Pruning
reflection_prompts: What painful pruning or discipline has God used in the past to yield peaceable righteousness?
How can viewing trials as loving refinement transform your perspective on current struggles?

passages.title: Built Up in Him
reflection_prompts: What spiritual anchors keep you grounded when cultural currents pull in other directions?
What are three specific things you are overflowing with gratitude for today?

passages.title: Remain and Bear Much Fruit
reflection_prompts: What does remaining in Christ look like in your most fruitful area?
What branch needs pruning so you can bear more fruit before the challenge?

passages.title: The Vine and the Branches
reflection_prompts: What does abiding in Christ look like practically during your busiest moments?
How does recognizing that 'apart from Me you can do nothing' reshape your daily dependence on God?

themes.name: Joy & The Harvest
themes.description: Persevering with joyful hope and laboring in the abundant harvest of God's kingdom.

passages.title: Reaping in Due Season
reflection_prompts: Are you feeling weary in well-doing? What biblical promise renews your spiritual strength?
How does God's guarantee that you will reap in due season encourage you to not give up?

passages.title: Reaping in Joy
reflection_prompts: If you have walked through a season of sorrow, what comfort does God's promise of joy bring?
How can you bring encouragement to someone who is currently sowing in tears?

passages.title: Lift Up Your Eyes
reflection_prompts: Who in your community or sphere of influence is ready for a word of hope and truth?
How can you lift up your eyes to perceive God's harvest field around you?

passages.title: Sent into the Harvest
reflection_prompts: Who are you praying for God to send as workers into your field?
What one step of labor can you take this week before the challenge?

passages.title: The Plentiful Harvest
reflection_prompts: How is God prompting you to be an active laborer in His harvest field right where you are?
What is your prayer for more workers to be sent into God's spiritual harvest fields?
